safety.disclaimer: NutriAI provides food-based dietary formulation recommendations designed to support nutritional intake. It does not replace medical advice, diagnosis, or clinical treatment. Changes in lab parameters must not be attributed solely to NutriAI products and should be evaluated by a healthcare professional.
safety.ageOutOfScope: NutriAI formulation models are validated exclusively for adolescent girls and women of reproductive age (10–49 years).
safety.severeWarning: Your haemoglobin value is critically outside typical reference ranges. Immediate medical consultation with a physician is required before using dietary products.
safety.moderateReferral: Your blood test reflects values outside standard reference ranges that a healthcare provider should review.
safety.pregnancyAdvisory: Pregnancy or lactation requires personalized obstetric evaluation. Food products serve strictly as supplementary nutritional support.
safety.nonIronPattern: Your test values show microcytic indices with normal or high ferritin stores. This suggests possible non-iron related factors (such as thalassaemia trait). High-dose iron supplementation is not advised without medical evaluation.
